opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Approximately £130,000 value; Trust contributes 100% of the Fellow's total salary costs up to a maximum of £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, with the balance paid by the host university, plus up to £6,000 per annum in research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by the time they take up the Fellowship; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Provides 3-year fellowships enabling early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, with the aim of leading to a more permanent academic position.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except studies of disease/illness and clinical/medical research

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other institutions of higher education, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations. Applicants must already be employed by the eligible institution or be academics with close links following retirement.
opportunities.summary: Detailed application stage for researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project (invited applicants who passed the outline stage).

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas. Applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers who coordinates the visit.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except studies of disease/illness and clinical/medical research

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers; a centre may be based at a single university or be a collaboration between multiple institutions.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The next round (Leverhulme Centenary Research Centres) is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career academics at UK universities with research degree awarding powers; must have at least two years full-time or equivalent research/teaching experience post-PhD and hold, or be nominated with an undertaking to offer, a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: For talented early career scholars to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship; resident in the UK at the time of application.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research. Application materials will be available on this page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except studies of disease/illness and clinical/medical research

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post; live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks a year and hold or have held a teaching and/or research post at a UK university with research degree or taught degree awarding powers or an eligible independent research organisation.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication. Application materials will be available on this page during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except studies of disease/illness and clinical/medical research

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Outline Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other institutions of higher education, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations.
opportunities.summary: Outline stage of the Research Project Grant scheme for innovative and original research projects. The outline stage is currently paused and will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026.
